Ocean Views, Timeless Charm, and Endless Potential in Westlake Highlands

Nestled in the sought-after Westlake Highlands neighborhood of Daly City, this charming Henry Doelger home offers breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, Sutro Tower, Downtown San Francisco and the tip of the Golden Gate Bridge. With classic character, thoughtful updates, and room to expand, this is a rare opportunity in a prime coastal location.

The main level features 2 comfortable bedrooms, 1 full bath, warm hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and an updated kitchen with modern finishes. Public records show the home as a 3-bedroom, 1-bathoffering a hint at its flexible potential. The lower level, where a third bedroom once stood, has been opened up and now serves as a blank canvas, ready for your personal touchcreate a guest suite, home office, or additional living space. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped backyard, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the coastal breeze.

Just minutes from the beach, Westlake Shopping Center, scenic hiking at Mussel Rock, Lake Merced, golf at the Olympic Club or Lake Merced Golf Course, and iconic dining at Westlake Joesthis location offers the perfect balance of natural beauty, convenience, and community. A Must See!!
